scores.tell: Envelope paper is soft matte with gentle sheen and a clean photo; very close to real set. Slightly smooth paper, no fibre.
Cauldron is one uniform lacquered plastic; big soft blobs of specular on belly and rim, no matte/gloss variation, no metal truth.
Binocular viewer is glossy chrome and blue plastic with strong reflections; city reflections in lenses; bevelled glassy look. Little matte variation.
Stone table and stools are matte but have a soft airbrushed gradient with no grain or chips; background foliage is fine. Reads like clay.
Helmet is all high-gloss plastic, with a huge glassy amber visor highlight and shiny white shell, statue-like like the grade 1 cat.
Backpack has soft fabric matte with straps and buckles at a small scale. Slightly felt-like and puffy, and the metal buckles are small and flat.
Door has painted wood and fine ivy leaves. Wood is smooth with no grain, and wall texture is a subtle painterly mottle; a little noisy and AI-smeared.
Keyboard has a matte-satin red shell, crisp keys and a mix of matte stand with small highlights. Very close to the real set; only slightly uniform plastic.
Cooler has glossy plastic with wet cans and ice. Mix is okay, but the shell is lacquered all over and the sand is noisy and grainy.
Drum kit is all shiny gold and chrome and glossy blue with a uniform lacquer; heavy specular on every part and little matte.
